stories.title: A live biotherapeutic product for adult allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation recipients: a partially randomized, placebo-controlled phase 1b trial
stories.takeaway: A two-cohort phase 1b trial evaluated SER-155 for gut microbiome disruption and bloodstream infection risk after allogeneic transplantation.
stories.what_happened: A two-cohort phase 1b trial evaluated SER-155 for gut microbiome disruption and bloodstream infection risk after allogeneic transplantation.
stories.method: Open-label and placebo-controlled cohorts with microbiome conditioning and follow-up.
stories.why_it_matters: An early clinical translation test of cultivated multi-strain microbiome therapy.
stories.read_first: Review safety, engraftment and the randomized cohort denominators.
stories.caveat: Small phase 1b trial; efficacy and infection prevention require larger studies.

stories.title: Disease-specific alterations in plasma fatty acids and arachidonic acid metabolites in ulcerative colitis and crohn’s disease
stories.takeaway: Investigators report disease-associated differences in circulating fatty acids and arachidonic-acid metabolites across IBD groups.
stories.what_happened: Investigators report disease-associated differences in circulating fatty acids and arachidonic-acid metabolites across IBD groups.
stories.method: Comparative plasma lipid/metabolite profiling in UC and Crohn's disease.
stories.why_it_matters: May refine metabolic biomarker hypotheses for intestinal inflammation.
stories.read_first: Inspect patient stratification and medication confounders.
stories.caveat: Observational metabolic signatures do not establish causality.

stories.title: Targeting hypersialylation in pancreatic cancer microfluidic models reverses its malignant phenotype and enhances CAR-T therapy
stories.takeaway: Microfluidic pancreatic cancer models were used to test targeting tumor hypersialylation alongside CAR-T treatment.
stories.what_happened: Microfluidic pancreatic cancer models were used to test targeting tumor hypersialylation alongside CAR-T treatment.
stories.method: Cancer microfluidic modeling and therapeutic perturbation.
stories.why_it_matters: A translational demonstration of human-relevant microfluidic immunotherapy testing.
stories.read_first: Inspect controls separating glycan perturbation from CAR-T effects.
stories.caveat: Preclinical microfluidic responses do not establish patient efficacy.

stories.title: Microwell-based nDEP multifunctional microfluidic system for single-cell capture and analysis
stories.takeaway: A microwell platform combines negative dielectrophoresis with microfluidics for single-cell handling.
stories.what_happened: A microwell platform combines negative dielectrophoresis with microfluidics for single-cell handling.
stories.method: Microwells, nDEP manipulation and cell-analysis measurements.
stories.why_it_matters: Expands controllable cell isolation methods for engineered biological platforms.
stories.read_first: Assess capture efficiency, viability and throughput.
stories.caveat: Performance may depend on cell type and electrical operating conditions.

stories.title: Functional readouts of neural organoids
stories.takeaway: Review compares calcium/voltage imaging, patch clamp and multielectrode array recordings in neural organoids.
stories.what_happened: Review compares calcium/voltage imaging, patch clamp and multielectrode array recordings in neural organoids.
stories.method: Methodological review of electrophysiology and optical functional assays.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights the need for functional validation beyond morphology in advanced in-vitro models.
stories.read_first: Start with measurement tradeoffs and electrode–tissue coupling.
stories.caveat: A review, not a new head-to-head benchmark.

stories.title: Gut microbiome of children with Autism Spectrum Disorder associates with clinical severity
stories.takeaway: Shotgun metagenomics of 720 children with ASD and 151 matched controls examines microbiome associations with symptom heterogeneity.
stories.what_happened: Shotgun metagenomics of 720 children with ASD and 151 matched controls examines microbiome associations with symptom heterogeneity.
stories.method: Stool metagenomics and clinical severity stratification.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates the importance of phenotype-resolved microbiome cohort design.
stories.read_first: Inspect covariate control, subgroup sizes and external replication.
stories.caveat: Association does not imply microbial causation or treatment benefit.

stories.title: Seasonal dynamics in lettuce phyllosphere microbiota and potential transfer to the human gut
stories.takeaway: Study explores seasonal changes in lettuce-associated microbial communities and potential gut exposure.
stories.what_happened: Study explores seasonal changes in lettuce-associated microbial communities and potential gut exposure.
stories.method: Seasonal phyllosphere microbiome profiling and transfer-oriented analysis.
stories.why_it_matters: Links food-associated microbial ecology to questions of human microbial exposure.
stories.read_first: Examine evidence distinguishing exposure from stable gut colonization.
stories.caveat: Potential transfer is not proof of durable engraftment.

stories.title: Integrative animal model and pilot clinical study reveal the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of Modified Wumei Pill against intestinal inflammation
stories.takeaway: DSS colitis experiments, CD4 T-cell assays and a small UC trial investigate Th17/glycolytic responses.
stories.what_happened: DSS colitis experiments, CD4 T-cell assays and a small UC trial investigate Th17/glycolytic responses.
stories.method: Mouse colitis, cell differentiation assays and randomized pilot clinical study.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates triangulation between mechanistic and preliminary human inflammatory endpoints.
stories.read_first: Inspect trial sample size, randomization, comparators and adverse events.
stories.caveat: Small pilot study cannot establish clinical efficacy or general safety.

stories.title: Low-voltage, ultra-broadband wearable MEMS ultrasound: a frequency-merged, wafer-scale framework for continuous in vivo cardiovascular imaging and monitoring
stories.takeaway: A wearable pMUT array reports 81.7% bandwidth at 5 Vp drive.
stories.what_happened: A wearable pMUT array reports 81.7% bandwidth at 5 Vp drive.
stories.method: MEMS transducer design, fabrication and cardiovascular sensing characterization.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows advances in low-power, scalable biomedical instrumentation.
stories.read_first: Inspect comparisons against commercial imaging and longitudinal stability.
stories.caveat: Device performance is not equivalent to clinical outcome validation.

stories.title: Genotoxic safety and long-term engraftment dynamics of efficient translational CRISPR/Cas9 therapeutics for β-haemoglobinopathies from bench to clinical trials
stories.takeaway: Review examines safety and durability issues in genome-edited hematopoietic therapeutics.
stories.what_happened: Review examines safety and durability issues in genome-edited hematopoietic therapeutics.
stories.method: Literature synthesis of gene editing and long-term follow-up.
stories.why_it_matters: A useful translation and safety perspective for advanced biological therapeutics.
stories.read_first: Read genotoxicity testing and follow-up limitations.
stories.caveat: Review does not provide new prospective clinical outcomes.
